channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: MAS surprise tightening supports SGD – HSBC
item.description: HSBC’s Abhilash Narayan notes that the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) unexpectedly tightened policy on 27 July 2026 by raising the Singapore Dollar (SGD) Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) slope to 1.25%.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains firmly as lower oil prices ease foreign reserve concerns
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its winning streak against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair falls to near 95.65 as a further decline in oil prices has strengthened the Indian currency.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Lower oil prices ensure further weakness for Canadian Dollar
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades marginally lower to near 1.4113 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The Loonie pair edges down as the Canadian Dollar (CAD) outperforms its major currency peers.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Risk-off and RBA tone weigh on Aussie – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman reports the Australian Dollar (AUD) has been the worst performing G10 currency overnight despite being the best performer year-to-date.

item.title: Swiss Franc: SNB on hold view boosts funding role – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner highlights a Bloomberg source story suggesting the Swiss National Bank (SNB) may keep its policy rate at 0.00% until end-2027, aligning with ING’s own forecast.

item.title: Gold languishes below $4,050; eyes further losses as focus remains on FOMC decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Tuesday and currently trades just below $4,050, down nearly 0.80% for the day.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Close July call keeps Dollar traders data-focused – BNY
item.description: BNY strategists John Velis and David Tam expect the Federal Reserve (Fed) to keep the federal funds rate unchanged at the upcoming July Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, while stressing it is a close call.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Political fragmentation clouds zloty outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose highlights that Poland’s Law and Justice party has split, with Mateusz Morawiecki forming Development Plus and polling above the Sejm threshold.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar shows resilience ahead of Fed meeting
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, July 28:

item.title: US Dollar: Stronger into FOMC on hawkish expectations – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar (USD) has reversed early-week losses and is trading near year-to-date highs ahead of tomorrow’s Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens on easing safe-haven demand, US tariffs
item.description: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the seventh successive day, trading around 0.8190 during the European hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold: Supported by lower oil prices and yields – ING
item.description: ING’s Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report that Gold has moved higher on Monday as falling Oil prices ease inflation concerns and weigh on the US Dollar (USD) and Treasury yields.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah drops as Bank Indonesia shakeup
item.description: USD/IDR extends gains for the second successive day, trading around 18,130 during the early European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces pressure following the surprise resignation of Bank Indonesia (BI) Governor Perry Warjiyo on Monday.

item.title: WTI Oil flirts with the $80 level amid speculation about US-Iran peace talks
item.description: Oil prices remain depressed on Tuesday, as hopes of a new round of peace talks between the US and Iran boosted hopes of a de-escalation of the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Energy risks could trigger further tightening – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists interpret Monetary Authority of Singapore's (MAS) July 2026 MPS as a calibrated tightening via a modest increase in the Singapore Dollar (SGD) Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) slope to an estimated 1.25% per annum, smaller than April’s move.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Trades vulnerably near 1.3300 ahead of Fed-BoE policy
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades with caution at around 1.3300 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Equities: China chip competition weighs on global markets – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that renewed concerns over Chinese competition and AI investment spending triggered a sharp selloff in global semiconductor stocks. Asian technology indices suffered heavy losses, while ASML and other chip-related shares declined in the United States and Europe.

item.title: Oman presents Hormuz fee proposal to Iran
item.description: According to a Gulf source, Oman presented a proposal for a joint regional mechanism to Iran to manage the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage for almost 20% of the global energy supply, with voluntary fees, Reuters report.

item.title: Euro stands tall against the British Pound despite the risk-off sentiment
item.description: The Euro (EUR) consolidated gains, just below three-week highs against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday, trading sideways at the mid-range of the 0.8550s at the time of writing.

item.title: Brent: Price slide reflects de-escalation hopes – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank strategist Charlie Lay, notes Brent Oil tumbled 8.7% to USD 88.36, reversing much of last week’s surge as US–Iran tensions eased and markets priced in de-escalation.

item.title: Euro revisits monthly low against US Dollar in countdown to Fed’s policy
item.description: The Euro (EUR) falls to its monthly low at around 1.1362 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair weakens as the US Dollar extends gains amid caution ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Slides to 0.6970 after failing to clear 38.2% Fibo. hurdle
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts some follow-through selling following the previous day's failure to find acceptance above the 0.7000 psychological mark and weakens to the 0.6970 area during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds position above nine-day EMA near 186.00
item.description: EUR/JPY holds ground after two days of losses, trading around 186.20 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency cross is holding a bullish near-term bias as it trades above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs), keeping the broader uptrend supported.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles above mid-0.5700s as USD stays firm ahead of FOMC meeting
item.description: The NZD/USD pair turns lower for the second consecutive day following a modest Asian session uptick to the 0.5785 region on Tuesday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index remains subdued near 101.50 amid Fed policy uncertainty
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground after three days of gains and trading around 101.50 during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $57.50 despite easing Fed hike bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) declines after registering nearly 0.5% gains in the previous day, trading around $57.50 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen flattens against US Dollar while Fed’s policy takes centre stage
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades flat against the US Dollar (USD) at around 163.75 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday. The USD/JPY pair struggles for direction as investors have sidelined ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.

item.title: RBA’s Bullock: Key question is whether tightening already delivered is enough to slow inflation
item.description: Speaking at the Anika Foundation Fundraising Lunch in Sydney on Tuesday, Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock said that the “key question is whether tightening already delivered is enough to slow inflation.”

item.title: Japan's Katayama: Need to communicate JGB market before budget compilation
item.description: In the Asian trading session on Tuesday, Japan Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama highlighted the need to communicate to financial and Japanese Government Bonds (JGBs) markets regarding the administration’s intentions towards the fiscal policy stance.
